Exercise A

Reading: PESTEL Analysis

Read the text, then choose the correct answer for each question.

Read the text

PESTEL is a framework for analyzing market opportunities. Political factors include government regulations and trade policies. Economic factors are interest rates, exchange rates, and GDP growth. Social factors involve cultural trends and consumer preferences. Technological factors include innovation and digital trends. Environmental factors are sustainability concerns. Legal factors cover labor laws and compliance requirements.
